description: The figure is a horizontal bar chart illustrating the number of tasks associated with different language-family group labels. The category axis is the vertical axis, listing (top to bottom) IE-Slavic, IE-Romance, IE-Germanic, Uralic, IE-Baltic, IE-other, IE-Indic, Semitic, Turkic, and Basque; the bars are not arranged alphabetically and appear ordered by decreasing bar length from top to bottom. The value axis is the horizontal axis labeled “# tasks,” shown on a linear scale with tick marks at regular 10-unit intervals from 0 to 80. Each category is represented by a single solid-colored bar: IE-Slavic (light blue) extends to just under 80 (≈79), IE-Romance (dark blue) to just under 50 (≈47), IE-Germanic (light green) to about 44, Uralic (green) to about 20, IE-Baltic (pink) to about 17, IE-other (red) to about 15, IE-Indic (tan) to about 10, Semitic (orange) to about 8, Turkic (lavender) to about 4, and Basque (purple) to about 3. No legend is shown, and there are no visible annotations or special emphasis beyond the distinct bar colors.
